analysis_trace: Trial: Phase II single-arm study of TIPS plus half-dose donafenib (100mg BID) in BCLC-C HCC with PVTT-associated portal hypertension (N=40)

Evidence sources: (1) Xie et al. 2023 (PMID: 38130294) - TIPS in HCC with main PVTT, median OS 10.0 months; (2) Frontiers 2025 - Donafenib+TACE ORR 69.4%, DCR 91.7%, median PFS 10.7 months; (3) PMC11993997 - Donafenib-based triple therapy ORR 64%, median PFS 9.0 months; (4) PMC6727815 - TIPS stent-graft primary patency 66% at 6 years, ~80-90% at 1 year
Population matching: AHCC with PVTT and portal hypertension, Child-Pugh ≤13, newly diagnosed, ECOG 0-1

Evidence role assessment: Donafenib data supports mechanism but full-dose; half-dose is unvalidated. TIPS data is direct for population. Numeric use: indirect_direction for donafenib efficacy (dose mismatch), direct_numeric for TIPS patency

Key uncertainties: (1) Half-dose donafenib (100mg BID vs standard 200mg BID) may reduce efficacy; (2) No prior studies of TIPS+TKI combination; (3) Single-arm design limits comparative inference; (4) Portal hypertension may affect drug delivery
Safety considerations: Half-dose may improve tolerability; TIPS+TKI combination may increase bleeding risk; hepatic encephalopathy risk with TIPS
Trial-level prediction: Likely to show positive signals on portal hypertension control via TIPS; antitumor efficacy expected but attenuated by half-dose; overall uncertain for regulatory success

search_verification.supports: TIPS in HCC with main PVTT: median OS 10.0 months, 1-year OS 45%, technical success 93.75%, symptom control 100%
Donafenib+TACE: ORR 69.4%, DCR 91.7%, median PFS 10.7 months
Donafenib-based triple therapy vs sorafenib: ORR 64% vs 40%, median PFS 9.0 vs 4.62 months
TIPS with stent-graft: primary patency 66% at 6 years, secondary patency 98% at 4 years, median survival 42.8 months in general portal hypertension
Donafenib+TACE+ICI: ORR 60.0%, DCR 93.3%, median PFS 11.8 months, grade≥3 TRAEs 40%

value.estimand: Single-arm DoTH group, RECIST 1.1 or mRECIST, up to 1 year
value.uncertainty: Half-dose unvalidated; direct evidence limited to full-dose donafenib combinations showing ORR 60-69%
value.rationale: Full-dose donafenib+TACE shows ORR 60-70%. Half-dose (100mg BID) expected to reduce efficacy. PVTT population historically poor response. Predicted ORR 35% (20-50% range).

value.estimand: Single-arm DoTH group, from TIPS start, death from any cause, up to 2 years
value.uncertainty: TIPS alone in PVTT gives median OS 10 months; donafenib monotherapy 12.1 months; combination effect unknown
value.rationale: TIPS alone in main PVTT: median OS 10.0 months. Donafenib may add incremental benefit but half-dose limits effect. Predicted median OS 10.5 months.

value.estimand: Single-arm DoTH group, from TIPS to progression or death, mRECIST/RECIST 1.1, up to 2 years
value.uncertainty: Full-dose combinations show PFS 9-12 months; half-dose expected 25-30% reduction
value.rationale: Donafenib+TACE shows median PFS 10.7-11.8 months. Half-dose and TIPS combination without chemotherapy likely less effective. Predicted median PFS 7.5 months.

value.estimand: Single-arm DoTH group, CR+PR+SD, RECIST 1.1 or mRECIST, up to 1 year
value.uncertainty: TKI+DCR typically high; full-dose donafenib combinations show 91-93%
value.rationale: Full-dose donafenib regimens show DCR 91-93%. Half-dose may reduce to ~75-80%. Stable disease achievable even with partial response reduction.

value.estimand: Single-arm DoTH group, color Doppler assessed, at 12 months
value.uncertainty: Covered stent-graft TIPS shows 80-90% 1-year patency; tumor thrombus may increase occlusion risk
value.rationale: Modern covered stent-grafts achieve 80-90% 1-year patency. PVTT may increase thrombosis risk but TIPS flow typically maintains patency. Predicted 85% at 12 months.

value.estimand: Single-arm DoTH group, GI bleeding/ascites/pleural effusion/gastropathy, within 6 months
value.uncertainty: TIPS effectively controls portal hypertension complications; TACE+TKI may increase bleeding risk
value.rationale: TIPS provides effective portal decompression with symptom remission in >85% patients. Anticoagulation from TIPS and antitumor effect may reduce thrombosis. Predicted 20% recurrence at 6 months.

trial_outcome_prediction.rationale: TIPS component likely effective for portal hypertension control with expected patency 80-85%. Half-dose donafenib efficacy is uncertain - may show signals but likely suboptimal compared to full-dose. No control arm limits definitive assessment. Primary endpoint ORR expected positive but modest (~35%).
